name: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited
source: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited audited consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026 (PricewaterhouseCoopers Incorporated, unmodified opinion), consolidated statement of financial performance and other comprehensive income, figures in R thousand and stored here in ZAR. CRON 2026-10-14 FY2026 column added from the audited statement, which prints Revenue 28,325,184, operating profit 1,372,976, profit before taxation 1,680,588, income tax 434,693 and a profit for the year from continuing operations of 1,245,895. Ties in the filing: Revenue 28,325,184 less operating costs 25,721,056 plus other income 38,875 less administrative expenses 1,270,027 equals operating profit 1,372,976; profit before taxation 1,680,588 less income tax 434,693 equals profit for the year from continuing operations 1,245,895 exactly. Source URL https://www.wbho.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/WBHO-Audited-Annual-Financial-Statements-for-the-year-ended-30-June-2026-2-1.pdf

reconciliation_note: FY2026 from the audited statement: Revenue 28,325,184 less Operating costs 25,721,056 plus Other income 38,875 less Administrative expenses 1,270,027 equals the printed Operating profit of 1,372,976. Profit before taxation 1,680,588 less Income tax 434,693 equals Profit for the year from continuing operations of 1,245,895; discontinued operations added 17,411 for a profit for the year of 1,263,306, of which 1,210,711 is attributable to shareholders, matching this file FY2025 column of 1,241,667, and 52,595 to non-controlling interests, so the Net Profit row stores the attributable figure. Earnings per share 23.156 Rand, the printed headline earnings per share from total operations of 2,315.6 cents, which is the basis this file FY2025 column of 23.374 already uses (the printed FY2025 headline figure is 2,336.6 cents); the printed basic earnings per share from total operations for FY2026 is 2,295 cents. Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, Net Finance Costs and Gross Margin are left empty for FY2026 because the audited statement does not print a gross profit or a cost of sales line at all, it prints operating costs, so the split in this file older columns is a secondary feed model that cannot be reproduced from the filing and mixing it with an audited figure in the same row would be wrong. The printed net finance position for FY2026 is a net income of 242,072, being finance income 296,429 less finance costs 54,357, and the 73,310 share of profits from associates and joint ventures less the 7,770 associate impairment take operating profit to profit before taxation.
